programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Guy Fieri road trips across America to check out classic greasy spoons; with a new generation of owners and delicious homemade food, these are the kind of places that make America special.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: In the most extreme express lane challenge ever, Guy Fieri gives three all-star chefs one hour to make an upscale appetizer, entrée, and dessert using a total of only 12 ingredients! The winner gets to shop Flavortown Market for up to $20,000.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Guy and Hunter force celebrity couples to shop in separate halves of the store to make breakfast in bed.

programs.title: Freedom to Leave the House! Inogen Portable Oxygen
programs.desc: Regain independence and enjoy greater mobility with the compact design and long-lasting battery of portable oxygen.

programs.title: 2026 Silver Eagle is here & it is a once-in-a-lifetime coin!
programs.desc: Join your hosts Kevin Cash & Cory Cady as we discuss the 250th Anniversary of America with the official "America 250" logo on a Silver American Eagle label; we are locking in orders for this iconic release, but coins are limited! Don't miss out!

programs.title: BBQ Brawl
programs.desc: The contenders serve BBQ treats that bring the heat; captains Bobby Flay, Anne Burrell and Sunny Anderson put chile peppers center stage, and they'll have to balance their heat to tantalize the judges' taste buds and not blow out their palates.

programs.title: BBQ Brawl
programs.sub_title: Takin' It to the Next Level
programs.desc: Captains Bobby Flay, Anne Burrell and Sunny Anderson challenge each other to create some next-level tailgate barbecue; the contenders grill up some mind-bending BBQ mashups.

programs.title: Chopped Castaways
programs.desc: In a test of primitive skill, the remaining six chefs wade into the lagoon to secure their protein and must elevate their fresh catch using only what the island provides. Later, the bottom two chefs face a prickly crustacean in a fiery Gauntlet showdown.

programs.title: Chopped
programs.desc: Inspired by hash browns and energized by eggs, four chefs wake up the judges' palates using baskets packed with breakfast foods; two chefs battle with breakfast sandwiches as entrées, while a strange coffee and meat dish prove challenging.

programs.title: Chopped
programs.desc: Four carnivorous chefs take on a bold breakfast sandwich and Berkshire bacon in the appetizer basket; the final two chefs are not concerned about how to include bacon in their desserts, but the cruel clock gives them plenty to worry about.

programs.title: Chopped
programs.desc: The chefs find a salty veggie and a dried fruit in the appetizer basket; in the entrée round, a carnival treat meets a Tex-Mex staple in the form of a strange mashup ingredient; chefs come up with ideas for creative cakes in the final round.

programs.title: Bobby's Triple Threat
programs.desc: Bobby Flay's Titans face off against their friend and master of modern Korean cuisine, chef Esther Choi; friends become enemies, and Esther has many as both the Titans and the clock work to take her down in front of judge Francis Lam.
